intro.text: Duke Roial's formal, rather aloof seon.

items.text: Once seons fell out of favour after the Reod, Roial kept Opa at home instead of taking him everywhere. There, fittingly for a seon whose Aon means flower, Opa oversaw the gardeners on Roial's large estate in Kae.

At Roial's eclipse-viewing party, Opa reported that Lord Redeen had got drunk and fallen into a pond, and Roial told him to get Redeen dry and send him home. Never having heard Roial speak of a seon, Sarene was surprised, and put Opa's coolness down to how people had come to view seons since the Reod.

appearance.text: Like any seon, a melon-sized ball of light. He speaks in a stern, flat voice.
